pay_detail: Fee varies by camp. The page says scholarships are available.
name: DiscoverU Teen Camps
what_you_do: Short career and hobby camps for teens, taught by professional educators and experts. Camps cover areas that can lead to careers.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 10 to 18. Each camp sets its own age range, and the student must meet it by the first day of camp.
deadline_text: The page says registration will open February 2027. Dates will be posted soon.
how_to_apply: Register online at parkland.edu/ceRegister, by phone at 217-351-2235, or in person at Community Education, 1315 North Mattis Ave, Champaign. Ask about scholarships on the page.
notes: Camps cost money. Check each camp page for its price and ages. Scholarships are for families with financial need and are first-come, first-served.
